picks.title: 369 | Gregg Caruso on Living Well Without Free Will
picks.summary: The worry about debates over free will is that they degenerate into semantics -- what do you mean by "free will," really? But there are important substantive issues that shouldn't be ignored. Do people deserve blame for doing wrong things? Can we make choices that create meaning for our lives? Philosopher Gregg Caruso denies the reality of free will, but is in favor of making good choices, as he discusses in his new book How to Live Well Without Free Will. Listen or watch Rolex Planet Visionaries wherever you get your podcasts. #ad            Blog post with transcript:  https://preposterousuni
picks.reason: Philosophical discussion on free will, ethics, and meaning in life.
